$comment: Reference source repositories for evaluation only. NOT application dependencies. Restore with: npm run refs:fetch. Record checked-out SHAs with: npm run refs:lock.

packages.name: cpal
packages.capabilities: Cross-platform audio device enumeration and input/output stream callbacks (CoreAudio, WASAPI, ASIO, ALSA, AAudio, iOS).
packages.integration: Direct crates.io dependency of crates/voiceloop-engine (already adopted).
packages.limitations: Raw device I/O only: no mixing, resampling, routing, or duplex synchronisation. Input and output are separate streams with independent clocks.

packages.name: midir
packages.capabilities: Cross-platform realtime MIDI input/output (CoreMIDI, WinMM/WinRT, ALSA, JACK, Web MIDI).
packages.integration: Direct crates.io dependency when MIDI work begins (Milestone 1/4).
packages.limitations: Input callbacks run on a backend thread with host timestamps; mapping to the audio clock is our job. No MIDI file parsing.

packages.name: rtrb
packages.capabilities: Wait-free single-producer single-consumer ring buffer suitable for the realtime audio thread.
packages.integration: Direct crates.io dependency of crates/voiceloop-engine (already adopted).
packages.limitations: SPSC only. Fixed capacity chosen at construction.

packages.name: fundsp
packages.capabilities: Composable audio graph notation, oscillators, filters, envelopes, reverb, delay, dynamics; realtime-safe graph processing.
packages.integration: Candidate crates.io dependency for synths/effects in Milestone 4. Evaluate allocation behaviour of graph edits first.
packages.limitations: API evolves between versions; heavy generic types increase compile time. No pitch detection or time stretching.

packages.name: rubato
packages.capabilities: Synchronous and asynchronous (sinc / polynomial) sample-rate conversion, realtime-capable with preallocated buffers.
packages.integration: Candidate crates.io dependency for device-rate vs project-rate conversion and clock drift correction.
packages.limitations: Resampling only; not a pitch shifter or time stretcher.

packages.name: tracktion_engine
packages.capabilities: Full DAW engine: Edit/Track/Clip model, tempo and time-signature sequence, transport, audio and MIDI recording, loop recording, clip launcher, plugin hosting, rendering.
packages.integration: Architectural reference. Direct use would mean a C++/JUCE engine and GPL-3.0 or a paid licence.
packages.limitations: Requires JUCE (git submodule, skipped in shallow retrieval). Large C++ codebase; GPL/commercial licensing.

packages.name: juce
packages.license: AGPL-3.0 or commercial JUCE 9 EULA (examples ISC)
packages.capabilities: C++ application framework: audio device manager, audio/MIDI I/O, DSP module, plugin hosting (VST3/AU/LV2), GUI, iOS/macOS/Windows targets.
packages.integration: Architectural reference. Direct use implies replacing the Rust engine with C++ and AGPL or a paid licence.
packages.limitations: Large. Licensing obligations for closed distribution.

packages.name: waveform-playlist
packages.capabilities: Browser multitrack waveform display, selection, trimming, fades, recording, mixing and export (Web Audio).
packages.integration: UI reference for waveform rendering and editing interactions; audio paths are Web Audio and would not be reused.
packages.limitations: Web Audio engine; not suitable as our realtime engine.

packages.name: mloop
packages.capabilities: Browser live looper: recording modes, overdub, sync, undo.
packages.integration: Behavioural reference only (AGPL-3.0). Do not copy or port code.
packages.limitations: AGPL-3.0; Web Audio implementation.

packages.name: pitchy
packages.capabilities: McLeod Pitch Method fundamental-frequency detection with clarity (confidence) output.
packages.integration: Algorithm reference; MPM is straightforward to implement natively (or use the Rust pitch-detection crate).
packages.limitations: JavaScript; single-pitch (monophonic) only.

packages.name: essentia.js
packages.capabilities: WASM build of Essentia: onset detection, beat tracking, key, pitch (YIN, Melodia), spectral features.
packages.integration: Reference only unless AGPL obligations or an Essentia commercial licence are accepted.
packages.limitations: AGPL-3.0. WASM in the webview would put analysis on the UI side, against our architecture.

packages.name: signalsmith-stretch
packages.capabilities: High-quality polyphonic time stretching and pitch shifting (header-only C++).
packages.integration: Candidate for direct native integration via a small C++ shim + cc/bindgen, or an existing Rust binding crate.
packages.limitations: C++ build integration required; depends on signalsmith-linear (separate repo).

packages.name: rnnoise
packages.capabilities: RNN-based speech noise suppression at 48 kHz, 10 ms frames.
packages.integration: Optional, user-enabled, offline/clean-up processing only. Pure-Rust port (nnnoiseless) exists.
packages.limitations: Speech-trained: damages musical transients and sustained tones. Model weights are downloaded separately (not retrieved).

packages.name: tone.js
packages.capabilities: Musical transport (BPM, time signature, loop points), lookahead scheduling, Time notation ('4n', '1m'), synths, effects.
packages.integration: Reference for musical time abstractions and transport API design. Not used for realtime audio.
packages.limitations: Web Audio based; scheduling depends on the browser audio clock and JS timers.

packages.name: audiokit
packages.capabilities: Swift audio framework for Apple platforms: AVAudioEngine graph helpers, recording, playback, MIDI, taps, effects and offline rendering.
packages.integration: Architecture and platform-layer reference for VoiceLoop Pocket. A narrowly scoped Swift dependency is possible if the future iOS audio session layer needs it.
packages.limitations: Apple-platform Swift stack, not reusable in the Rust realtime engine. Large framework; adopting it could create a second audio graph beside CPAL.

packages.name: dswaveformimage
packages.capabilities: SwiftUI/UIKit waveform analysis, static waveform rendering, and live microphone waveform views for iOS and macOS.
packages.integration: Mobile interaction and rendering reference. Direct use only if VoiceLoop Pocket develops a native Swift waveform surface rather than the shared React UI.
packages.limitations: Visualization only; no pitch, onset, recording model or editing engine. Native Swift views do not drop directly into the Tauri webview.

packages.name: whisper.cpp
packages.capabilities: Local Whisper inference in C/C++ with Apple acceleration, quantization, timestamps, VAD options and iOS examples.
packages.integration: Candidate offline engine for optional lyric/speech transcription on recorded ideas. Run outside realtime callbacks through a bounded background job.
packages.limitations: Model files are not fetched and can be hundreds of MB. Speech transcription is not melody transcription; CPU, memory, battery and multilingual accuracy require device testing.

packages.name: tract
packages.capabilities: Pure-Rust inference engine for ONNX and TensorFlow models with tractable graphs and CPU execution.
packages.integration: Candidate runtime for a small on-device percussion or audio-tagging model while preserving the Rust engine boundary.
packages.limitations: Inference runtime only: it does not supply a trained model, feature design or training pipeline. Model execution must stay off the realtime callback.

packages.name: linfa
packages.capabilities: Rust classical machine-learning toolkit including clustering, nearest neighbours, linear models, SVMs and preprocessing.
packages.integration: Reference/candidate for training a tiny per-user trigger classifier from extracted onset features outside the audio callback.
packages.limitations: General ML toolkit, not an audio classifier. We must define realtime-safe features, validation, persistence and a compact inference path.

packages.name: midly
packages.capabilities: Low-level, allocation-conscious Standard MIDI File parsing and writing in Rust, including no_std support.
packages.integration: Candidate direct dependency for deterministic MIDI clip export/import after event cleanup and clock mapping.
packages.limitations: File representation only; no realtime MIDI ports, quantization, note cleanup, tempo inference or musical semantics.

packages.name: aubio
packages.capabilities: Mature C implementations of onset detection, beat/tempo tracking, pitch detection, silence detection, notes and spectral descriptors.
packages.integration: Algorithm and behavior reference only unless GPL obligations are accepted. Useful comparison target for onset, tempo and monophonic pitch tests.
packages.limitations: GPL-3.0: do not copy, translate or link into a closed build. C/Python project and not a ready per-user beatbox classifier.

packages.name: librosa
packages.capabilities: Python music-information-retrieval toolkit: STFT, mel/MFCC, chroma, onset strength, beat tracking, tempo, pitch and effects.
packages.integration: Permissive offline research oracle for feature experiments, classifier prototypes and golden-vector generation; not an app dependency.
packages.limitations: Python/NumPy stack is unsuitable for the realtime engine and mobile shipping path. Production algorithms still need native independent implementations or suitable crates.

packages.name: basic-pitch
packages.capabilities: Neural audio-to-MIDI transcription with pitch bends and polyphonic note events, plus model and post-processing reference code.
packages.integration: Offline comparison/reference for derived MIDI capture and cleanup. Evaluate model conversion and performance before any optional background integration.
packages.limitations: Python/TensorFlow-oriented and not designed as a low-latency live controller. Model inference is heavier than VoiceLoop's current monophonic YIN path.

packages.name: beat-this
prune: tests/It Don't Mean A Thing - Kings of Swing.mp3
packages.capabilities: State-of-the-art neural beat and downbeat tracking with pretrained checkpoints and evaluation code.
packages.integration: Offline benchmark/reference for free-take BPM/grid detection and beat placement quality.
packages.limitations: Python/PyTorch model is too heavy for the realtime callback and likely too heavy for default mobile use. Checkpoint size and license must be reviewed separately.

packages.name: audioset-tagging-cnn
packages.capabilities: PANNs training and inference for AudioSet-scale audio tagging, embeddings and sound-event detection.
packages.integration: Research reference for optional instrument/content tags and embedding-based search of recorded ideas.
packages.limitations: Python/PyTorch and pretrained checkpoints are not fetched. General AudioSet tags are not song-section labels and may be too broad for personal music search.
